```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from compare import comparison_table, coefplot, render_table
```

## Balanced vs unbalanced---IDN consumption, urban

The five covariate sets fan across the columns; balanced and unbalanced versions are grouped under the column spanners.
Stars: <sup>\*</sup> p<0.10, <sup>\*\*</sup> p<0.05, <sup>\*\*\*</sup> p<0.01.
Standard errors in parentheses.

```{python}
#| label: idn-bal-vs-unb-table
#| output: asis
fix    = {"country": "IDN", "depvar": "consumption", "choice": "urban"}
versus = {"unbalanced": "cuu", "balanced": "cub"}

table = comparison_table(fix=fix, versus=versus)
print("```{=html}")
print(render_table(table))
print("```")
```

```{python}
#| label: idn-bal-vs-unb-coefplot
#| fig-cap: "Point estimates with 95% CI by covariate set, balanced and unbalanced offset within each row."
#| out-width: "100%"
coefplot(fix=fix, versus=versus);
```

The corresponding sters live in [RP7/output/](../../RP7/output/) under the names `grc_IDN_cuu_*.ster` (unbalanced) and `grc_IDN_cub_*.ster` (balanced).
Each cell loads five sters (main + `_n` + `_a` + `_d` + `_g`).
